goal: Do not send fallback text for empty intermediate LLM turns while the internal tool-loop agent is still running, and never silently swallow a final empty LLM result.

acceptance_criteria.description: A tool-loop LLM result with no components is treated as an empty intermediate turn and is skipped before the respond stage.
A tool-loop LLM result containing only blank Plain text is treated as an empty intermediate turn and is skipped before the respond stage.
A tool-loop LLM result containing non-blank Plain text remains sendable.
A final empty LLM result is yielded to RespondStage so the user gets an explicit fallback instead of no reply.
